name: drop-confirm
title: Drop Confirm
description: The target names exactly what will move and where, ignores a drop before the pointer has rested on it, asks once before large moves or moves that change who can see the items, and offers Undo, with a Move here button for keyboard and touch.

mistakes: drag and drop moved wrong folder
meta.summary: A drop target that names what will move and where, ignores flick drops and offers Undo, so files and folders don't land in the wrong place.
meta.server: Re-check permissions for the destination on the server, and support undo for moves that change sharing.
catches: Drops that land in passing, before the pointer settles (settleTime)
Moves into a different space that change who can see the items
limits: Item counts and spaces come from your drag data and props
Undo calls your onUndo; it can't reverse a move your backend already finalised
a11y: Each target is a role="group" labelled with the destination and described by its status
A Move here button gives keyboard and touch users the same action, with a counted aria-label
The confirm step focuses Cancel; Escape closes it
